claimBoundary: This artifact records calibration status and declared sensitivity cases. It does not convert modeled priors into observations or interpret engineering sensitivity as probability.

limitations: No pinned CPPI row snapshot is checked in.
No documented mapping from CPPI score or vessel time to arrival rate, service-time distribution, or berth count is available.
The checked-in medianHoursInPort values are seeded model priors and must not be described as CPPI observations.

stochasticUncertainty.appliesTo: average queue wait across simulated arrivals

emissionsSensitivity.validationContext: The IMO study documents operational emissions-intensity variability and the importance of vessel phase, speed, power, auxiliary load, fuel, and emissions factors. It does not provide probability weights for these Simulatte parameter cases.

interpretation.warning: Low/high results are deterministic joint parameter cases, not p05/p95, prediction intervals, or confidence intervals.

limitations: Parameter bounds are declared engineering scenarios, not statistically calibrated vessel distributions.
Cases move parameters jointly and therefore are an envelope stress test, not one-at-a-time attribution.
Weather resistance, hull fouling, draught, auxiliary machinery detail, and vessel-specific measurements remain absent.
